FIRST TIME WITH THE CREW?

YOU’RE
ALREADY IN.

You don’t need to earn your place here.

  1. Check the plan. Meet at Royal Glenora Parking Lot on Wednesdays at 18:00. Check the latest run update for the route and any seasonal time changes.
  2. Come as you are. Wear comfortable shoes, bring water, and dress for the weather.
  3. Say hello. Let the crew know it’s your first time and find a comfortable pace together.

Start times may shift with the seasons. Check the latest club update before heading out.
